title: strict JSON reads a number as u64
prompt: In memprove-protocol's strict JSON module (crates/memprove-protocol/src/strict_json.rs), add `JsonValue::as_u64` next to `as_i64`: it returns the value as a `u64` when it is a JSON number written as a non-negative integer (no sign, no fraction, no exponent) that fits in a `u64`, and `None` for anything else, including numbers above `u64::MAX`. Document it like the other accessors and keep `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
